All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, 5 minutes from the Pride village.

faq.a: Marbella Pride is typically held over the last weekend of June. For 2045, exact dates will be confirmed by the Marbella Town Hall around early 2045. The main parade and concerts usually take place on Saturday, with events spanning Friday to Sunday.

faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from the Pride village?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about a 5-minute drive or a 20-minute walk from the Pride village, which is usually set up along the Golden Mile or near the Marbella bullring. Most yachts depart from the port's main dock, so you can easily combine a boat party with the on-land festivities.

faq.q: Can I bring my own decorations or music?
faq.a: Yes, you're welcome to bring decorations like rainbow flags, balloons, or banners. Most boats have a Bluetooth or AUX connection for your playlist. Just keep it respectful of the vessel – no glitter or confetti that could damage the upholstery. Your skipper can advise on what's allowed.

faq.q: What's included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), the price is fixed at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, rates are on request.

faq.q: Can we stay out after sunset?
faq.a: Yes, most charters can be extended into the evening, especially in June when sunset is around 21:30. You'll see the coast lights from the water – a great backdrop for photos. Just confirm with us via WhatsApp when booking, as some boats have limitations on night navigation.

faq.q: Is there a minimum number of guests?
faq.a: No minimum – you can book for just 2 guests on the smaller boats (e.g., Dubhe or Mariah SX21). For the larger yachts, the price is per boat, not per person, so it's cost-effective if you split with friends. Our fleet ranges from 5 to 12 guests per boat.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: The skipper will assess conditions on the day. If it's unsafe to sail, we'll offer a full refund or reschedule. In June, Marbella averages 28°C and calm seas, so cancellations are rare. We recommend booking early to secure your preferred slot.

faq.q: How do I book a yacht for Pride?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp on the number shown on our website. We'll confirm availability, send you the boat details, and arrange payment on arrival at Puerto Banús. No deposit needed. Book at least 2 weeks in advance for Pride weekend, as boats fill up fast.

Marbella Pride 2045 is set to be the biggest celebration of diversity on the Costa del Sol. If you're looking for a unique way to join the festivities, a Marbella Pride 2045 yacht party from Puerto Banús offers a floating VIP experience. This guide covers everything: boat options, prices, what's included, and how to book. Whether you're a group of friends or a couple, you'll find a vessel that fits your vibe and budget.

Why a Yacht Party for Marbella Pride 2045?

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of Marbella's luxury scene, and during Pride weekend the marina becomes a rainbow-coloured hub. A yacht party lets you escape the crowds while staying close to the action. You'll cruise the Mediterranean with your own playlist, drinks, and a skipper who knows the best spots – from the iconic La Concha mountain backdrop to the exclusive villas of the Golden Mile. Plus, you can anchor near the beach clubs for a swim between Pride events.

Our Fleet for Pride 2045

We offer a range of boats departing from Puerto Banús. Here's a quick overview:

All prices include 21% IVA, fuel, skipper, drinks, and snacks. See the full fleet here.

How to Book Your Pride Yacht

Booking is straightforward. Contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send you the boat details. No deposit is needed – you pay on arrival at Puerto Banús. For Pride weekend, we recommend booking at least two weeks in advance, as slots fill quickly.

What's Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper (speaks English & Spanish)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% tax)

There are no hidden extras. You can bring your own rainbow decorations, but please avoid glitter or confetti that could damage the upholstery.

Suggested Itinerary for Pride Day

A typical 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús might include:

  • 11:00 – Board at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper
  • 11:15 – Depart towards Cabopino, passing the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina
  • 12:00 – Anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim
  • 13:00 – Cruise back, with views of La Concha mountain
  • 14:00 – Return to Puerto Banús, ready for the Pride parade

Longer charters (8 hours) can include lunch at a beach club or a stop at Estepona's coastline.

Pricing Breakdown

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. All inclusive.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80 white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours. Jet ski included free.
  • Other boats: Pricing on request via WhatsApp. No deposit required.

For groups of 10–12, the Mangusta 80 works out at about €393 per person for 4 hours – competitive for a luxury yacht with jet ski.
